rules: Stop proposing fundamental-minus-fundamental rank spreads: three failed the cheap screen this round (|t| 0.15, 0.80, 0.98) and the one that cleared scored 0.042. Every spread that scored above 3 had exactly one fundamental leg against a price or volume leg (3.106, 3.407, 4.559).

When crossing a fundamental with a price leg, use a magnitude leg (range, TS_STD($return, w), ABS($return)/$dollar_volume, range-vs-volume corr) rather than a directional displacement leg. Distance from TS_MAX($high, w), $open - TS_MEAN($open, 5), TS_MAX($high,21)/$high and a downside/total return ratio screened at |t| 0.96, 0.78, 0.26 and 0.65; CS_RANK-ing the displacement leg did not save it.

Inside the range-vs-volume TS_CORR kernel, put a TS_RANK on the volume leg: TS_RANK($dollar_volume, 21) at 63 days scored 4.383 and TS_RANK($volume, 10) at 21 days scored 3.248, while a bare $volume leg at 84 days screened at 0.76 and a TS_DELTA($dollar_volume, 5) leg at 63 days screened at 0.72. $high - $open works as the range partner alongside $high - $low.

Keep TS windows at 63 days or shorter whenever a fundamental leg is in the expression: a 126-day TS_RANK($close) crossed with CS_ZSCORE($operating_margin) missed coverage at 0.883, while 63-day price windows crossed with $leverage and $roe legs all cleared.

Changing only a window does not decorrelate. Moving TS_RANK($high - $low, w) from 10 to 126 inside the same $roe spread still hit rho 0.915. Change the operator or the field of the price leg instead, and once one spread off a given fundamental is live, treat that fundamental's whole spread family as spent.

Prefer SIGN or other direction-only wrappers on fundamental deltas over cross-sectional ones. SIGN(TS_DELTA($leverage, 63)) times a range rank accepted at 2.964, while CS_DEMEAN(TS_DELTA($leverage, 63)) and CS_DEMEAN(CS_RANK(TS_DELTA($leverage, 126))) products screened at 0.65 and 0.26.

Three proposals were thrown away as within-run duplicates. Check this run's own proposal log, not just the archive, before submitting; the repeats were all re-tries of shapes proposed earlier in the same run.

A crossover child of a two-term rank spread must keep three parent nodes. Both attempts on CS_RANK($roe) - CS_RANK($volume) rewrote or multiplied onto the volume leg and counted only 2 shared nodes; graft inside a leaf while leaving the operator and both rank wrappers intact.
Avoid $open differenced against a DELAY'd prior-day OHLC field: that block is 5 shared nodes with the Alpha#101 family and gets rejected before it is ever scored.
